summary.text: Sam Powell is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent John Jasinski (R).
He won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary with 79.2% of the vote over Adama Doumbouya.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Powell said he was born and raised in California in a church community led by his father, who was a pastor, and that he later became a pastor in the same denomination.
He said he and his wife moved to Faribault in 2023 to start over, at age 60.
Powell named healthcare access, taxes on the wealthy, and funding for schools, libraries and the arts among his priorities in the survey.
He listed the DFL and the Rural DFL Caucus as endorsers.
